intro: If you want a Ratchaburi stay that looks good, photographs well, has a cafe built in, and sits close to town for low-hundreds-to-low-thousands baht — Sleep by Me Ratchaburi is one of the new openings everyone keeps mentioning · It's a boutique hotel built from a renovated 3-storey shophouse on Petchkasem Road, styled in cute pastel pink, with 28 rooms across 6 types from singles to family rooms · The ground floor is Sip by Me Cafe, serving coffee, toast and cake with photogenic corners · It's near Makro and about 1 km from Ratchaburi town centre, with rooms from around ฿790/night — a sharp deal for a fresh-design stay in town.

body.html: Ratchaburi has seen a steady wave of new boutique stays riding the cafe and check-in-photo trend, and Sleep by Me Ratchaburi is one that comes up often · The idea here was simple: take an old 3-storey shophouse on Petchkasem Road and turn it into a pastel-pink boutique hotel, with a cafe on the ground floor and rooms above · This format is increasingly popular in second-tier towns because you get both a place to sleep and a cafe in one spot, which suits travellers who want a good-looking stay with photo-worthy corners.

There are 28 rooms across 6 types — 12 Standard Double, 6 Standard Twin, 2 Deluxe, 2 Family, 2 Single and 4 Triple — covering solo travellers, couples and families · Every room has air-con, TV, a fridge, a hairdryer, bathroom toiletries, drinking water, towels, hangers and free Wi-Fi · Guests most often praise that the rooms are cutely decorated, clean and the beds are comfortable, especially the Deluxe rooms, which reviewers describe as beautifully styled with a princess-style bed, a clean bathroom and a small in-room fridge.
"A brand-new stay, rooms decorated beautifully, clean, comfortable beds, with a cafe downstairs that's great for photos, reasonable price, and close to town so it's easy to get around."

What sets Sleep by Me apart from ordinary stays in the same price band is Sip by Me Cafe on the ground floor · It runs as a full cafe serving coffee, drinks, toast and cake, with photo corners decorated in the same style as the building · Guests can come down for a morning coffee or a quick photo session without going anywhere · For anyone who loves cafe-style stays and a photogenic atmosphere, this is the main reason they pick this place · Free parking is available for those driving in.

The location is on Petchkasem Road in Chedi Hak — near Makro and about 1 km from Ratchaburi town centre · That's very close to town: a few minutes' drive reaches the Koykee old market area, the Mae Klong riverside, Wat Mahathat Worawihan and the Ratchaburi National Museum · Khao Kaen Chan (the town viewpoint) is close, and Khao Ngu Stone Park is a short drive away · It suits travellers who want a fresh-design stay near town, whether as a base for exploring Ratchaburi or a stylish overnight stop en route south or toward Kanchanaburi.

On scores, Sleep by Me Ratchaburi rates very well on review platforms — notably around 4.7 out of 5 on Google from over a hundred reviews · To be honest, though, the review count on booking platforms like Agoda and Booking is still thin because it's a new opening · The repeated praise is for beautifully decorated, clean rooms, comfortable beds, the in-house cafe, great photos, attentive staff and good value · The things to know: this is a hotel inside a building, with no swimming pool and no pets allowed, and the rooms are boutique town rooms rather than a spacious resort.

Honestly, Sleep by Me Ratchaburi isn't a luxury resort and never set out to be · Its selling point is a fresh-design stay in town, a pink shophouse that photographs beautifully, an in-house cafe, clean rooms with soft beds, close to the town centre, for low-hundreds-to-low-thousands baht · If your trip is about exploring Ratchaburi town, you love cafe-style stays and good photos, and you want a convenient near-town location — this fits perfectly · But if you're after a resort with a pool, plenty of green space, or pet-friendly rules, look elsewhere, because this is a tidy, good-looking boutique hotel in a town building, kept simple.

A tip from following the reviews here closely: there are only 2 Deluxe rooms, and they're the ones most praised for their decor, so book early if you want the prettiest room · Prices vary a fair bit by room type (roughly ฿790 up to ฿1,400+), so compare room types and dates before booking · Come down to Sip by Me Cafe on the ground floor for photos and coffee — it's a highlight not to miss · And since it sits on a main road, ask for a room away from the street side if you're sensitive to noise.

honestSummary: Sleep by Me Ratchaburi is the fresh-design boutique stay near town that fits travellers who love cafes and photos — a beautifully styled pink shophouse, clean rooms with soft beds, an in-house Sip by Me Cafe, and a convenient near-town location, for low-hundreds-to-low-thousands baht · It's not a resort, has no pool and no pets, and is a hotel inside a town building, but for exploring Ratchaburi town or a good-looking overnight stop, it delivers just right.
honestChecks: If you want a resort with a pool or wide green grounds — this is a boutique hotel inside a town building with no pool → reset expectations and focus on the room design and cafe, which are the genuine highlights, or look at the hillside / Suan Phueng resorts instead.
If you're travelling with a pet — pets are not accepted here → look at pet-friendly stays in Ratchaburi instead.
If you're sensitive to traffic noise — the hotel is on busy Petchkasem Road → request a room away from the street side when booking, and pick free cancellation if you're not sure yet.

faq.q: Where is Sleep by Me Ratchaburi and how do I get there?
faq.a: It's at 99/9 Moo 8, Petchkasem Road, Chedi Hak, Mueang Ratchaburi, near Makro · It's about 1 km from Ratchaburi town centre, a few minutes' drive to the Koykee old market, the Mae Klong riverside, Wat Mahathat Worawihan and Khao Kaen Chan · There's free parking, it suits self-drivers, and being on a main road it's easy to reach.

faq.q: How much does Sleep by Me Ratchaburi cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from around ฿790/night in normal periods, with most rooms roughly ฿790-฿1,400 · There are 6 types — Standard Double/Twin, Single, Triple, plus Deluxe and Family rooms · Every room has air-con, TV, a fridge, a hairdryer, toiletries and free Wi-Fi · Prices vary by room type and date, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Sleep by Me Ratchaburi have a cafe?
faq.a: Yes · The ground floor is Sip by Me Cafe, a full cafe serving coffee, drinks, toast and cake, with photo corners decorated in the same pastel-pink style as the building · Guests can come down for a morning coffee or a quick photo session without going anywhere — it's a highlight of the stay.

It's best for travellers exploring Ratchaburi town who love fresh-design stays, cafes and good photos · The rooms are cutely decorated, clean, with soft beds, plus a Family room for groups, and a near-town location · If you want a resort with a pool, wide green grounds, or a pet-friendly stay, this may not be it — look at the hillside or Suan Phueng resorts instead.

faq.q: What are the review scores and what should I know?
faq.a: Real guest scores are very good, notably around 4.7 out of 5 on Google from over a hundred reviews (roughly 8.6 out of 10) · Common praise is for beautifully decorated, clean rooms, comfortable beds, the in-house cafe, great photos and good value · Things to know: it's a hotel inside a building with no pool, no pets, the booking-platform review count is still small as it's new, and it sits on a main road — ask for an inner room if noise concerns you.
